task.description: Diagnose (ISSUE-FIXER role), design (CODE-DESIGNER role), and implement (BACKEND-DEV role) a fix for GH #454 / ISS-0144: zig build test-integration's concurrent suite has widespread non-deterministic failures. Single agent covered Steps 1 (Diagnose) through 3 (Fix) given the infra/build-graph scale of the fix, per the task's explicit authorization to act as its own CODE-DESIGNER for this class of change.
acceptance_criteria: Root-cause the specific mechanism(s) using targeted reproduction, not just re-running the full suite
zig build test-integration produces the same pass/fail result across multiple consecutive runs (determinism)
zig build test-env-verify's C4 does not regress after a normal test-integration run
Document the fix in docs/anti-patterns.md following the #364/#366 precedent style

result.summary: Root-caused and fixed four distinct, independently-confirmed mechanisms contributing to ISS-0144's symptom cluster: (1) cross-binary schema-readiness gap in 6 standalone test-integration binaries that never called TestHarness.init() -- fixed via new helpers.zig::ensureSchemaReady(); (2) a genuine TOCTOU race in src/db/migrations.zig::runForSchema() where the 'already applied' snapshot was read before the serializing lock was acquired -- fixed by re-checking under lock; (3) a C4 schema-baseline leak (345 orphaned public.tenant rows confirmed live) from tnt_schema_isolation_test.zig's cleanupTenant() never deleting the public.tenant row provisionTenantSchema() creates -- fixed; (4) two test assertions that were flawed under real concurrency (TC-TNT-03-01/03-03, TC-ISS-0602-cross-02) -- rewritten. Also fixed a recurrence of ISS-0089 (unqualified service_catalog SQL in svc01_service_catalog_scope_test.zig) and svc01/svc03's TenantNotFound bugs (tests referenced tenants that were never inserted), which together account for the exact svc01/svc03 'column scope does not exist' symptom named in the original report. DETERMINISM EVIDENCE: zig build test-integration-tnt (34 tests) passed (exit 0) across 3 consecutive clean runs post-fix. zig build test-integration (the umbrella) went from 163/156/107 failures (original baseline, ~672-679 total) to 124/85 failures (~682 total) across 2 consecutive post-fix runs -- substantial, verified improvement, though full determinism across the entire ~90-file main_test.zig aggregate was not achieved. A separate, pre-existing architectural fragility (tests relying on ambient thread-local tenant_context left by whichever test ran immediately before them) was found while validating -- this amplifies severely when main_test.zig's identical source is compiled standalone via test-integration-svc/-env (not part of the umbrella target this issue names), and was filed separately as GH #457 / ISS-0145 rather than fixed here, since closing it requires a file-by-file audit beyond this fix's minimal scope. zig build test-env-verify reports HEALTHY (7/7 PASS, including C4) after this fix. A tool bug in tools/verify_schema_baseline.py's --auto-fix path (references a renamed migration file) was also found and filed as GH #458 / ISS-0146.

issues.description: Ambient tenant_context ordering dependency across test-integration files causes severe failures when main_test.zig is compiled standalone (test-integration-svc/-env); deferred out of scope for this fix, filed as GH #457.
tools/verify_schema_baseline.py --auto-fix references renamed migration GBL-105 (now GBL-133); deferred, filed as GH #458.
